strings.CRO_THENEWORDER_DESC: From its inception, the Independent State of Croatia was a farce. An Axis puppet government borne out of World War Two and theoretically a monarchy led by an Italian king, it was practically in the hands of Ante Pavelić and his brutal Ustaše. With the collapse of the Axis and the death of Pavelić, the Italian empire reaffirmed its control over Croatia - ousting the Ustaše and placing the kingdom in the hands of a small cadre of Italian generals and advisors. With partisan activity still rampant in the country and the Ustaše now operating underground, the kingdom appears to be on its last legs - change is coming to the country, for good or for worse...

strings.CRO_the_partisan_problem_desc: Since 1941, partisans have constantly harangued the Balkan governments set up by the victorious Axis powers. However, they refuse to die, and Tito continues to lead terrorists in a campaign against the legitimate government.
strings.CRO_legacy_of_the_ustase_desc: The Ustaše never went away. They remain as a powerful political movement, and even worse, they feel betrayed by their Italian masters. It is probable that they are working with our rival, Germany, to work against us.
strings.CRO_bosnian_autonomy_desc: The Bosnians enjoy significant autonomy within the state. Whilst this may be necessary to keep the peace, it limits the central government's ability to control the population.
strings.CRO_the_sham_kingdom_desc: While forced behind Italian heels, many within Croatia; both the new King as well as the people, had hoped for some advancement from their benefactors. Instead, Croatia exists as nothing but a plaything entirely beholden to the whims of Rome, while receiving none of the benefits. We reside in a nation with a reluctant King, an embarrassing legitimacy, and an irrelevant autonomy. Something must be done to rectify this one sided relationship.
